verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a Linux distribution installed entirely on the user's own hardware (full-disk encryption, local firewall, Docker VM for Windows, dual-boot/partition install) rather than a hosted SaaS, so 'self-hosting' is inherent to how the product runs — there is no cloud-only version. missing for 10: no explicit documentation framing this as 'self-hosting' or comparing to a hosted alternative, and no independent confirmation of a hosted counterpart being avoided.
